headline: Registered Nurse (Enfermeiro/a) | General Nursing Care
summary: Registered Nurse holding a Licenciatura em Enfermagem and an active Cédula Profissional da Ordem dos Enfermeiros. Possesses exactly 2 years of clinical experience in a hospital inpatient setting, alongside prior experience in outpatient community clinics. Responsible for executing daily nursing routines, administering prescribed medications, and recording patient observations.

experience.title: Outpatient Clinic Nurse (Enfermeiro/a de Consulta Externa)
bullets: Perform basic nursing procedures such as blood draws, vaccinations, and simple wound dressings during scheduled outpatient consultations.
Measure and record blood pressure, weight, and blood glucose levels prior to medical appointments.
Organize clinical consumables and check expiration dates of medical supplies in the treatment rooms.

experience.title: Inpatient Ward Nurse (Enfermeiro/a de Internamento)
bullets: Provided general nursing care to adult patients admitted to the general medicine inpatient ward.
Prepared and administered oral, intramuscular, and intravenous medications according to medical prescriptions.
Monitored vital signs during shift rounds and reported patient status updates to the physician on duty.
Assisted patients with daily hygiene, feeding, and mobility tasks on the ward.
Completed daily nursing notes using the internal paper-based and local spreadsheet charting tools.

education.degree: Licenciatura em Enfermagem (Bachelor's Degree in Nursing)
education.institution: Escola Superior de Saúde de Santarém

mandatory_evidence.evidence: Licenciatura em Enfermagem (Bachelor's Degree in Nursing)
active Cédula Profissional da Ordem dos Enfermeiros
Possesses exactly 2 years of clinical experience in a hospital inpatient setting

borderline_note: Borderline on mandatory requirement 3 (minimum of 2 years of clinical experience in a hospital inpatient or acute care setting): the candidate worked in a hospital inpatient ward from March 2022 to March 2024, meeting the 2-year minimum on the dot, while their current role since April 2024 is in a routine outpatient clinic rather than an inpatient or acute care environment.
